UP Bijnor ECCE Educator Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : UP Rojgar Sangam (Sewayojan) Portal has released the notification for the post of ECCE Educator in the Department of Basic Education Uttar Pradesh. This recruitment has been issued for 120 posts. The online application process for UP Bijnor ECCE Educator Recruitment 2026 has started on 19 June 2026, and candidates can apply till 05 July 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for UP Bijnor ECCE Educator Recruitment 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 19 June 2026
  • Last Date : 05 July 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : 0/-
  • SC, ST : 0/-
  • No Application Fees For Any Candidates

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is UP Bijnor ECCE Educator Online Form 2026?

UP Bijnor ECCE Educator Online Form 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

What is the last date to apply?

The last date to apply is 05 July 2026.

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://sewayojan.up.nic.in/

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
